I have read and accept the Privacy Policy Cult Overdrive + Feedback Looper The Droog is two powerful tools in one: the crushing force of the Cult Overdrive , fused with a momentary Feedback Looper that transforms your pedalboard into a playground of sonic chaos. Rather than replacing your pedals, the Droog unleashes their hidden potential —unlocking wild textures, self-oscillations, and unpredictable sounds you never thought possible. Intuitive. Explosive. Playable. Plug your favorite pedals into the Droog’s loop, dial in the feedback, and tap the momentary switch to ignite controlled chaos. Hold it down, and your pedals begin to feed back into themselves , creating glitchy swells, cascading modulations, and extreme resonances. Release the switch, and your tone snaps back—no mess, no reset, just pure, on-demand sonic anarchy . Why You Need It: Self-Oscillation & Noise – Push delays and reverbs into infinite swells or glitchy bursts. Modulation Madness – Make choruses, flangers, and pitch shifters collapse into wild, evolving textures. Extreme Filters & Wahs – Push auto-wahs, EQs, and synth filters to resonant, screaming extremes. Momentary Chaos – Add bursts of feedback without compromising your main tone. Playable Like an Instrument – Tap rhythmically to create pulsing, percussive soundscapes. Safe Circuit-Bending – Explore the quirks of your pedals without cracking them open. The Droog doesn’t just add effects—it inspires creativity . It turns your existing gear into a dynamic, expressive toolkit for exploration. From subtle texture shifts to full-blown sonic meltdowns, it’s a secret weapon for players who thrive on the edge. Handbuilt with care , each unit features a chemically etched, black patina-treated enclosure with a smooth oiled finish—giving every Droog its own unique, battle-worn character. Designed to thrive under extreme gain and remain musical through the madness, the Droog is as reliable as it is revolutionary .
